classification.difficultyReason: Express the whole secant as x+2, form the secant product equation, factor the resulting quadratic and reject the negative root as an invalid length.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Two secants meet at an external point to the left of a circle. Segment labels are placed on their respective external and internal portions. Ordinary source colours are replaced by house black.
spec.mathematics: Upper secant: external length x and internal length 2 cm. Lower secant: external length 3 cm and internal length 5 cm. The external-length times whole-secant products are equal. Diagram is schematic.
spec.answerVisibility: Only x and the supplied lengths 2 cm, 3 cm and 5 cm are visible; the supplied answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
The products of the secant intercepts are equal.
$$\begin{align*}x(x+2)&=3(3+5)\\x^2+2x&=24\\x^2+2x-24&=0\\(x+6)(x-4)&=0\\x&=-6\text{ or }4\end{align*}$$
Since $x$ is a length, $x=4\text{ cm}$.
